About this item

  • MEET THE GENIUS1 — Similar to our G750, just better. It's 35% smaller and delivers over 35% more power. It's the all-in-one charging solution - battery charger, battery maintainer, trickle charger, plus desulfator.
  • DO MORE WITH GENIUS — Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, Gel, SLA, VRLA) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries, including flooded, maintenance-free, deep-cycle, marine and powersport batteries.
  • ENJOY PRECISION CHARGING — An integrated thermal sensor dynamically adjusts the charge based on ambient temperature, preventing overcharging in hot weather and undercharging in cold, ensuring optimal battery performance.
  • CHARGE DEAD BATTERIES — Charge batteries from as low as 1 volt, or use Force Mode to manually charge completely dead batteries down to zero volts. Perfect for recovering deeply discharged or neglected batteries.
  • BEYOND MAINTENANCE — Keep your battery fully charged without worrying about overcharging. Our smart charger constantly monitors the battery, allowing you to leave it connected safely - indefinitely - for worry-free maintenance.
  • RESTORE YOUR BATTERY — Precision pulse charging automatically detects and reverses battery sulfation and acid stratification, restoring your battery's health for improved performance and extended lifespan.
  • COMPATIBLE — Charges and maintains all types of vehicles, including cars, automobiles, motorcycles, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, classic cars, and more.
  • WHAT'S IN THE BOX — Includes a 1A charger, a direct wall plug-in, 110-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, and 3-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA.

Product Description

The GENIUS1 is the ultimate all-in-one solution for battery charging, maintenance, and restoration, delivering 35% more power in a 35% smaller design compared to its predecessor, the G750. Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, gel, flooded, and deep-cycle) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries (up to 30 amp-hours), it is compatible with a vast array of vehicles, such as cars, automobiles, motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, snowmobiles, golf carts, classic cars, and more; including automotive brands like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Bentley, Maserati, Lexus, Audi, Ford, Chevrolet, Corvette, Cadillac, Prius, Toyota, Subaru, Nissan, powersport vehicles such as Harley-Davidson, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Ducati, Indian, KTM, Husqvarna, Vespa, Polaris, Seadoo, as well as lawn and garden vehicles such as John Deere, Kubota, Toro and more. Featuring an integrated thermal sensor, the GENIUS1 adjusts its charging profile based on ambient temperature, ensuring optimal performance by eliminating the risk of overcharging in hot climates and undercharging in cold ones. It's capable of charging batteries as low as 1 volt and offers a Force Mode for manually charging completely dead batteries (as low as zero volts). With precision pulse charging, the GENIUS1 restores battery health by reversing sulfation and acid stratification, improving performance and extending battery life. Its advanced monitoring system allows for safe, indefinite connection, making it perfect for long-term maintenance. The package includes a 1A charger (120-240VAC), a direct wall plug-in, 110-inch DC cable with battery clamps and integrated eyelet terminals, all backed by a three-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA, the GENIUS1 combines power, reliability, and convenience in a compact design to keep your batteries ready for whatever lies ahead.

    NOCO Gets the Details Right
    I was skeptical at first because there are so many battery chargers/maintainers out there, but after using NOCO Genius chargers for a while, I’m genuinely impressed. I now own FOUR of them. I started with the NOCO Genius 1 for my Kawasaki SxS. It worked so well that I bought a second Genius 1 for my mom’s vehicle. Since then, I’ve added a Genius 2 for my own vehicle and a Gen5 X1 waterproof onboard charger for our boat. Everything about these chargers feels premium. The packaging is excellent, the cables are thick and durable, the LED indicators are bright and easy to see even across the garage during the day, and even the small details stand out — like the rubber feet on the bottom so the unit doesn’t scratch your toolbox or workbench. The Genius Cable Extension accessory has been AMAZING. No more struggling with clamps or leaving vehicle hoods open. Once the extension is attached to the battery posts, you simply plug the charger into the quick connect and you’re done. Super clean setup and extremely convenient. One of my favorite features is the memory setting. Once you select the battery type/mode, the charger remembers it even after being unplugged for a while. That’s incredibly useful after a power outage or if you move the charger around. I also really appreciate the thermal protection and smart charging features. During a 100+ degree day in my garage, I actually watched the charger reduce/pause charging to protect the battery from heat. Heat destroys batteries, so seeing the charger actively monitor conditions gave me a lot of confidence. I tested the maintainer function as well. Once the battery reached full charge, the indicator stayed green. Then I opened the doors and turned on the parking lights to create a battery draw. Within minutes, the NOCO detected the voltage drop and automatically started charging again. That’s exactly what you want from a smart maintainer. My personal thoughts on the models: Genius 1: Perfect for motorcycles, ATVs, UTVs, SxS, or vehicles that sit for long periods. Genius 2: Faster charging and better/more detailed status indicators. Gen5 X1: Excellent for marine applications since it’s waterproof and designed as a permanent onboard charger. Yes, these cost more than some cheaper chargers, but in my opinion, you absolutely get what you pay for. They don’t overcharge batteries, they intelligently monitor and maintain them, and the overall build quality is excellent. After owning four of them, my only regret is not buying them sooner.

      So I just bought a brand new one two years, but it’s because I never registered the warranty for our first one. This is basically a one piece kit that is a great starter for battery charging for most kinds of automotive and marine batteries. It’s very simple to use, and the one reason our last one stopped functioning is because of built in fail safes. In this case: my wife and I were washing our camper and this got wet and then got some dirt on it, it got through the water resistant seal and the charger could detect this. The great news is the charger will literally cease to function if it has become damaged. It will give a flashing red light, and you cannot put it into Force Charge mode. The only downside is unless you have a multimeter, you may not know that it has become damaged internally. I figured it out because of the mode not working, and it wouldn’t charge any batteries. The fuse was fine. So make sure you register this when you get it. It does the job and the only way you know it’s working is because of the status light, as it is beyond quiet. It’s basically a plug with the clamps for the battery terminals, so it is easy to store and carry around. I highly recommend this charger if you need something simple without a lot of functionality, just don’t leave it exposed to the elements.

      I used to buy and use another brand of low current charger / maintainers for my power equipment and vehicles. However that brand became cheaply made compared to their initial offering and at a much higher price too. Several died after a brief thunderstorm. I saw the NOCO Genius chargers on a YouTube product review channel called "Project Farm" where several brands of similar chargers were thoroughly compared. The NOCO Genius brand scored the best IMHO and was the only brand capable of charging a dead, or almost dead, battery. They are price competitive and now the only brand I will buy (I now own several 1A & 5A units). So far I am pleased with how well they work. One of them, attached to my backhoe, was exposed to wet weather during a violent storm and it wasn't affected buy it. Given the price of a group 31 battery these days, preserving their life without boiling them dry from over charging, is money well spent.

      Update (9/1/2026): In July 2026, just 9 months after purchase and placed in service on my John Deere backhoe, this unit failed. No lights lit and no output. Started a warranty claim, received an RMA number, send the charger to them at my expense with tracking showing it arrived on 8/21/2026 As of this update I have neither heard back nor have I received a replacement.

      I was initially happy but others have reported units failing as I have now experienced. So I am lowering my rating unit I receive satisfaction on my warranty claim.

      Update (9/2/2026): Today I received a replacement NOCO Genius1 for the defective unit I sent in to their warranty department. I was told to expect 2 - 3 weeks after receiving the defective unit and verifying it was indeed defective and not tampered with. I had not received any emails or text messages so when this unit arrived today, which was less than the estimate, I was caught off guard. I am now restoring the 5 star rating I had given this item previously. I'll keep this review updated if the replacement fails.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Excellent Battery Charger & Maintainer
      Reviewed in the United States on March 11, 2020
      Size: 1A
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have a truck that mostly sits in the garage. Every time I need to back it out of the garage, the battery is dead.

      I know that just sitting isn't good for batteries, not to mention this battery is several years old.

      Now keep in mind, this is a large amp battery for a SUV, which was so dead, a turn of the key and I didn't even get lights on the dash. I stuck this little charger on it and it took a day and a half, but it charged completely. Ok, now I'm beginning to get a tad impressed.

      I have two of those old type chargers, you know the ones that after a while you can hear the acid boiling inside the battery, and the battery is getting really hot... you know the chargers that tell you not to leave it on your battery for any extended period of time as this might (will) damage the battery (possibly even start a fire). Well... no more.

      I'm a total convert now to using smart chargers, and this one seems especially good. I really hope I don't find some little something that breaks 6 months from now, cause I really like this charger! It seems very well designed and made and most of all, it works great.

      The only negative I can find, it has a single button to select one of several charging modes, and LED's to indicate which option you have chosen, and those LED's are pretty much self explanatory, as well as an advanced mode where you have to push and hold the single button to enter advanced charging mode. For example, if your battery is so bad, the charger cannot detect there is even a battery hooked up, you can tell it to go ahead and start charging anyway which is a really nice feature. As another reviewer mentioned, when you need to use some of the more advanced functions, if you've lost the booklet, well... good luck. The multi-language booklet briefly explains all of the options, what the LED's mean, and that's pretty much it, verbose it isn't..

      It comes in a really nice packaging, like you're really getting something ( and you are), the unit itself seems well made and thought out, you would think a bit more of an effort would have been put into the manual.

      But, perhaps the product speaks for itself... and it does. And, after all most users will hook it up to their 12 volt car/boat/motorcyle battery, plug it in, select the regular 12v battery option, and that's all most will ever need. Once the battery is charged completely, the charger senses that, and switches automatically to just maintaining the battery. If you loose power while charging (or maintaining), this charger just picks up right where it left off, so there is no worries about pushing buttons or selecting modes, it knows what you were doing before, and starts right back up with doing it again.

      Am I glad I got it: Yes

      Would I buy it again: Yes.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Works with a REALLY low battery

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      My wife has a 1995 Mercedes SL320 that she did not drive all winter and well into the new year... when she opened the garage door and tried to start it the battery was dead, drained by MANY months of the old style mechanical clock running without the car being started so the battery could charge

      My (brand name withheld) several year old 10 amp 'smart' charger would not work because the battery was too low to be detected

      So, I looked for a different charger with a FORCE mode to get a dead battery to start charging... I connected this one at about 7PM at night (it never would go into force mode, since the battery had 'just enough' charge to be detected) and when I get in the car at 7AM the next morning the battery had enough of a charge for the dash lights to come on, but not enough to run the starter

      The PDF I downloaded shows that this 1 amp charger will take 'about' 23 hours to charge a 30 AH battery... the battery in her SL320 is a 100 AH model, so I will let the charger run for another full day before I try to start the car again (or maybe 2 days to get the charger enough time to work)

      So far, this charger is doing exactly what I need (I thought about a larger model to charge quicker, but decided that slow charging was good enough... she hasn't driven her car since last Fall, so she can now wait a day or two)

    About this Item

    • MEET THE GENIUS1 — Similar to our G750, just better. It's 35% smaller and delivers over 35% more power. It's the all-in-one charging solution - battery charger, battery maintainer, trickle charger, plus desulfator.
    • DO MORE WITH GENIUS — Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, Gel, SLA, VRLA) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries, including flooded, maintenance-free, deep-cycle, marine and powersport batteries.
    • ENJOY PRECISION CHARGING — An integrated thermal sensor dynamically adjusts the charge based on ambient temperature, preventing overcharging in hot weather and undercharging in cold, ensuring optimal battery performance.
    • CHARGE DEAD BATTERIES — Charge batteries from as low as 1 volt, or use Force Mode to manually charge completely dead batteries down to zero volts. Perfect for recovering deeply discharged or neglected batteries.
    • BEYOND MAINTENANCE — Keep your battery fully charged without worrying about overcharging. Our smart charger constantly monitors the battery, allowing you to leave it connected safely - indefinitely - for worry-free maintenance.
    • RESTORE YOUR BATTERY — Precision pulse charging automatically detects and reverses battery sulfation and acid stratification, restoring your battery's health for improved performance and extended lifespan.
    • COMPATIBLE — Charges and maintains all types of vehicles, including cars, automobiles, motorcycles, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, classic cars, and more.
    • WHAT'S IN THE BOX — Includes a 1A charger, a direct wall plug-in, 110-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, and 3-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA.

    Product Description

    The GENIUS1 is the ultimate all-in-one solution for battery charging, maintenance, and restoration, delivering 35% more power in a 35% smaller design compared to its predecessor, the G750. Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, gel, flooded, and deep-cycle) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries (up to 30 amp-hours), it is compatible with a vast array of vehicles, such as cars, automobiles, motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, snowmobiles, golf carts, classic cars, and more; including automotive brands like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Bentley, Maserati, Lexus, Audi, Ford, Chevrolet, Corvette, Cadillac, Prius, Toyota, Subaru, Nissan, powersport vehicles such as Harley-Davidson, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Ducati, Indian, KTM, Husqvarna, Vespa, Polaris, Seadoo, as well as lawn and garden vehicles such as John Deere, Kubota, Toro and more. Featuring an integrated thermal sensor, the GENIUS1 adjusts its charging profile based on ambient temperature, ensuring optimal performance by eliminating the risk of overcharging in hot climates and undercharging in cold ones. It's capable of charging batteries as low as 1 volt and offers a Force Mode for manually charging completely dead batteries (as low as zero volts). With precision pulse charging, the GENIUS1 restores battery health by reversing sulfation and acid stratification, improving performance and extending battery life. Its advanced monitoring system allows for safe, indefinite connection, making it perfect for long-term maintenance. The package includes a 1A charger (120-240VAC), a direct wall plug-in, 110-inch DC cable with battery clamps and integrated eyelet terminals, all backed by a three-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA, the GENIUS1 combines power, reliability, and convenience in a compact design to keep your batteries ready for whatever lies ahead.
